zh.title: 匈牙利空軍獅鷲戰機墜毀 飛行員彈射逃生
zh.summary: 匈牙利空軍獅鷲戰機墜毀；飛行員彈射逃生送醫
body: 匈牙利國防軍（Hungarian Defense Force）一架獅鷲（Gripen）戰機於2026年8月24日上午在索爾諾克（Szolnok）軍事基地附近墜毀。
匈牙利總理彼得·馬札爾（Péter Magyar）在社群媒體證實，一架獅鷲戰機在「幾分鐘前」墜毀，飛行員已成功彈射逃生。
國防部長羅穆盧斯·魯辛-森迪（Romulusz Ruszin-Szendi）表示，墜機發生在上午10點過後不久，事發地點位於索爾諾克軍事基地。
魯辛-森迪並說明，飛行員已由救護車送往醫院，初步報告顯示，現場無其他人員傷亡，也未對民用基礎設施造成損害。
目前墜機原因未知，匈牙利當局已展開調查。

en.title: Hungarian Gripen fighter jet crashes at Szolnok military base; pilot ejects safely
en.summary: Hungarian Gripen fighter crashes near Szolnok; pilot ejects and is hospitalised.
body: A Gripen fighter jet from the Hungarian Defense Forces crashed near the Szolnok military base on August 24, 2026. Prime Minister Péter Magyar confirmed the incident in a statement, saying the crash occurred "a few minutes ago."

According to the Prime Minister, the pilot was able to eject safely. Defense Minister Romulusz Ruszin-Szendi also confirmed the crash and said the incident occurred a few minutes after 10:00 local time at the Szolnok military base.
Ruszin-Szendi said in a video message that the pilot was taken to hospital by ambulance. He added that no one else was injured in the accident.
The reasons for the crash are currently unclear, and an investigation is underway. Unverified footage of the apparent crash site has been shared on social media.
Preliminary reports indicate no damage to civilian infrastructure, according to the Prime Minister.

zh.title: 印尼空軍Su-30戰機於望加錫機場偏離跑道
zh.summary: 印尼空軍Su-30戰鬥機於哈桑努丁機場偏離跑道；未造成商業航班中斷
body: 印尼空軍一架編號TS-3011的蘇愷-30（Su-30）戰鬥機，於2026年8月24日上午在位於南蘇拉威西省瑪羅斯的蘇丹哈桑努丁國際機場（UPG）偏離13跑道，最終停在跑道旁的草地上。
機場發言人Taufan Yudhistira向安塔拉通訊社證實，該起事件發生於西側跑道，現場處置工作正持續進行。機場商業航班營運維持由3,100公尺長的03-21跑道運作，未接獲航班中斷報告。印尼空軍尚未對事件原因或機組人員狀況發表聲明。
蘇丹哈桑努丁國際機場為軍民合用機場，駐紮於該機場的第11飛行中隊負責營運印尼空軍全部的蘇愷戰鬥機機隊。

en.title: Indonesian Air Force Su-30 Overruns Runway at Sultan Hasanuddin Airport
en.summary: An Indonesian Air Force Su-30 jet overran a runway at Sultan Hasanuddin Airport without commercial flight disruptions.
body: An Indonesian Air Force Sukhoi Su-30 fighter aircraft, registration TS-3011, ran off runway 13 at Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport (UPG) in South Sulawesi on the morning of August 24, 2026, coming to rest on grass beside the runway.

Airport spokesperson Taufan Yudhistira confirmed the excursion occurred on the western runway and said handling operations were underway. Commercial flights continued on the 3,100-meter runway 03-21, with no flight disruptions reported.

Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport operates as a joint civil and military airfield. The Indonesian Air Force has not issued an official statement regarding the cause of the incident or the status of the crew.

zh.title: 全日空推遠端機器人支援服務，首見跨機場系統
zh.summary: 全日空本月21日起於區域機場導入「newme」機器人；遠端客服品質達98.4%
body: 全日空（All Nippon Airways）宣布將於2026年8月21日起，在日本多座區域機場推出遠端旅客支援服務，合作對象為東京的AI與機器人新創公司avatarin。
此服務使用名為「newme」的機器人，由關西國際機場（KIX）的員工集中操作，使全日空成為首家推出此類跨機場遠端支援系統的日本航空公司。
全日空表示，此方案奠基於在羽田機場（HND）進行的測試，研究人員分析了超過25,000次客戶互動，發現絕大部分旅客問題（98.4%）都能以與現場服務相同品質遠端解決。
全日空指出，此舉是其結合人力服務與數位科技的中期策略一部分，公司將先評估計畫對客戶滿意度與營運表現的影響，再決定是否擴展至更多機場。

en.title: ANA to roll out remote robot support at regional airports as Japan's workforce shrinks
en.summary: ANA starts Aug 21 remote 'newme' robot passenger support from KIX; tests show 98.4% of queries resolved remotely.
body: All Nippon Airways (ANA) announced it will begin rolling out remote passenger support across multiple regional airports in Japan starting August 21, 2026, in partnership with avatarin, a Tokyo-based AI and robotics startup.

The service will use robots called "newme" operated centrally from Kansai International Airport (KIX)                                       , making ANA the first Japanese airline to launch this kind of inter-airport remote support system.

ANA said the approach builds on extensive testing conducted at Haneda Airport (HND)                                       , where researchers analyzed more than 25,000 customer interactions and found that 98.4% of passenger questions could be resolved remotely with the same quality as in-person service.
The airline said it will evaluate the program's effect on customer satisfaction and operational performance before deciding whether to expand the service to additional airports.

zh.title: 聯合航空因波音737 MAX 10延遲面臨全平躺座椅放置難題
zh.summary: 聯合航空執行長坦言波音737 MAX 10交付延誤；已訂購全平躺座椅無法適配其他機型。
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）執行長 Scott Kirby 表示，公司先前為波音 737 MAX 10 訂購的大批全平躺座椅無法安裝於其他機型。受到交付延誤影響，聯合航空預期首架 737 MAX 10 將延至 2027 年中至年末交付，該公司目前共有 167 架該型號的確認訂單。
波音 737 MAX 10 已於 2026 年 7 月 28 日完成最後一趟預定認證飛行，累計執行 976 架次與超過 2,060 小時測試飛行。在等待交付期間，聯合航空擴大了空中巴士 A321neo 訂單，並推出配有 20 張 Polaris 全平躺座椅的高階機型。

en.title: United Airlines Faces Seating Dilemma Over Delayed Boeing 737 MAX 10 Deliveries
en.summary: United Airlines faces a seating strategy dilemma; ordered lie-flat seats cannot fit other aircraft types.
body: United Airlines Chief Executive Officer Scott Kirby stated that the airline has lie-flat seats ordered for Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft that cannot fit on any other aircraft type. Boeing's ongoing delivery delays have pushed United's expected first 737 MAX 10 delivery to mid-to-late 2027. The airline currently maintains 167 firm orders for the aircraft model.

The Boeing 737 MAX 10 completed its final planned certification flight on July 28, 2026, accumulating 976 flight test missions and more than 2,060 flight hours. During the extended wait for the aircraft, United expanded its order for Airbus A321neo jets and introduced a premium-configured version featuring 20 Polaris lie-flat seats for transcontinental routes.
